decisions.reason: The particle therapy water phantom serves a small but strategic niche and costs little to keep listed, although its drop from a dedicated page to a mention in 2019 suggests weaker emphasis and leaves some uncertainty about its value.
Small volume ionization chambers are core catalog items with long life cycles and low holding costs, and the product kept its own page with no sign of failure.
This small field dosimetry chamber fits the firm's core competence and growing small field treatment techniques, so keeping it open is cheap and its outlook is positive.
A standard clinical chamber line with several models is a staple of reference dosimetry with steady demand, so there is no reason to abandon it.
Relative dosimetry chambers complement the firm's water phantoms and QA platform, and the low cost of keeping them justifies continuing.
Thimble chambers are established, low-cost products tied to calibration services, and the evidence shows continued presentation rather than signs of failure.
